population_oracle: minimum true distortion at most B in the SAME realized union of two fixed-tree pruning families and estimated-order contiguous family; diagnostic only

selection.objective: minimum completed exact coupled certificate over group counts <= B
selection.families: union of two preserved fixed trees and estimated-propensity contiguous partitions; selected partition belongs to one constituent
selection.baseline: B contiguous whole-state groups; greedily choose each cumulative cut closest to j*n/B while leaving one state per remaining group; earlier cut on exact ties
selection.recurrence_ties: each recurrence minimizes certificate, then group count/canonical partition/constituent among retained candidates; deterministic canonical local ties
selection.admission: completed finite optimum or baseline certificate, count <= B, G*certificate <= 3; unresolved is not infeasibility; no identity fallback below K
selection.pruning: complete the smallest-capacity baseline first; if finite M, a partial cell bound > M may be excluded, since that baseline remains feasible at all requested capacities; retain rejection lower bound and exact interval DP resolution

semi_synthetic.population: all 747 local IHDP rows, byte-identical to public CEVAE source; original treatment and outcomes unused
semi_synthetic.state: birth-weight quartile x maternal-age-above-median x infant sex; complete-reference exact linear quantiles; <= threshold ties; occupied tuples only declared before sampling
semi_synthetic.mass: reference-state count/747; exact uniform reference-record resampling, no dyadic mass rounding
semi_synthetic.sensitivity: G=2 conditional on the declared S; generated assignment independent of potential outcomes given S has actual sensitivity 1 within this class; no empirical real-world confounding claim

sampler.paired: one independent block per law/replication, shared across methods/capacities/profiles and nested outcome prefixes; share uniforms across outcome profiles
sampler.qualification: exact ideal integer/dyadic threshold construction; reproducible PRNG, no formal PRNG iid theorem

uncertainty: Continuous means: pointwise normal95 over independent blocks; individual binary rates: two-sided exact CP95; paired differences use within-block variation.
coverage_scope: assignment event simultaneous over all capacities; outcomes pointwise for prespecified capacity/profile/cohort size/method. No outcome-based selection, no nominal conditional coverage after admission
precision_reporting: report unconditional admitted-and-miss probability and abstention together; conditional admitted widths descriptive; [0,1] evaluation fallback separately identified and never a successful release
interpretation: explicit experimental reporting capacity, measured bytes and time only; pooled raw retains more information; no deployed institution, privacy guarantee, or measured administrative saving
